follow-up time: First half year of GBS testing (Feb 7 - Aug 6, 2017)
exposure: intrapartum PCR-testing for group B streptococcus (GBS)
cohort: Women presenting in the labor ward with pre-labor rupture of membranes for >14 h/rupture of membranes during delivery for >14 h, or labor between gestational weeks 35 0/7 and 36 6/7
finding: The introduction of the intrapartum GBS test in selected groups of women resulted in a reduction of antibiotic use to approximately 40% in the groups tested, without an increase of infection in mother or child.
